data.title: A2 · 整理白发
data.description: 回到临时住处，A2 坐在矮凳上拢起长发，准备系好再开始修理装备。背后的窗外是安静的废墟。
data.promptProse: Sitting on a weathered steel crate inside an overgrown factory ruin, A2 reaches up with both hands to gather her long silver-white hair into a ponytail. Sunbeams cut through gaps in the collapsed roof, illuminating climbing green vines and concrete pillars around her.
data.animaCaption: She gathers her hair before repairing her gear.
